Side task (not a StatsClaw run; ignore run-dir conventions). READ-ONLY design review of the Freight Recovery web app (React 19 + TS + Tailwind, B2B freight-claim recovery tool). Code at C:/Users/mariu/ventures/freight-recovery-build/web/src (branch feat/intelligence; another agent may be committing docs in this worktree — do not modify, stage or commit anything). No running app, no Figma: code-based review of JSX, CSS (web/src/styles/tokens.css, app.css; there is an existing styles/contrast.test.ts — read it), components/ui.

Your sub-agent: A11Y AUDITOR, target WCAG 2.1 AA. First read and follow: C:/Users/mariu/.claude/plugins/synced/ab91124c-b23a-4ccf-a5de-fd859dde2155_bd34c67d-d705-4586-b2a3-0b936f7841d7/d9cd42a0-66ef-46d4-8a8a-db154f6e2212/skills/shared/knowledge/accessibility.md and ux-heuristics.md (same folder) for the severity rubric.
Check: compute contrast ratios for every text/background and UI-component token pair actually used (show the math or a node one-liner you ran); labels on every input (htmlFor/aria-label), error identification + aria-describedby/aria-invalid, live regions for async status (uploads, approvals, toasts), focus visible (no outline-none without replacement), focus management on route change, dialogs (focus trap, Esc, return focus, aria-modal), tables (th/scope/caption), keyboard reachability of clickable divs, icon-only buttons, landmarks/skip link, heading order, touch targets ≥44px (WCAG 2.5.5 is AAA, 2.5.8 AA is 24px — say which), language attr, MFA/TOTP input (autocomplete="one-time-code"), password fields autocomplete, prefers-reduced-motion.
Severity: normal-text contrast fail or keyboard trap = P0; missing label = P1; etc. Every finding: file:line, criterion number, severity, effort S/M/L, fix. List >=3 things done well.
Write full findings to C:[REDACTED:high_entropy].md and return the table + counts (contrast failures, keyboard issues) + overall status, concisely.

handback.t:
## A11y audit (WCAG 2.1 AA): not yet conformant — 1 P0, 5 P1, 17 P2, 14 P3

The base is solid, and the blockers are narrow and quick to fix: the P0 and P1 items are about 1–2 days of work, mostly 1-hour (S) changes. This was a code-only review: no running app, no screen-reader or axe pass, so those still need doing on a live build. I modified nothing in the repo.

Full report: `C:[REDACTED:high_entropy].md`. It has 37 findings with file:line, criterion, severity, effort and fix, plus the full contrast table and checklist.
Contrast script: `.../scratchpad/design-review/contrast.mjs` (run with `node contrast.mjs`). It uses the standard WCAG luminance formula, ratio = (L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05).

**Contrast failures: 1 text, 2 non-text, 1 mitigated non-text.**
- All 18 text/background token pairs in use pass in the light theme, which is the only one shipped. Lowest: accent on surface, 5.23:1.
- The existing `contrast.test.ts` passes (4/4). It does not cover placeholder or non-text pairs, and it accepts a 1.3:1 border.
- The dark theme is never switched on anywhere (dead tokens).

| Pair | Ratio | Needed | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Placeholder (Tailwind default: text colour at 50%) = #878b95 on white | 3.41 | 4.5 | FAIL |
| `.input` border #cbd5e1 on white | 1.48 | 3 | FAIL |
| Command-palette active option #f0fdfa on white | 1.04 | 3 | FAIL |
| Active nav pill on sidebar | 1.00 | 3 | fails, but colour, weight and aria-current also show it (P3) |

**Keyboard and focus: 11 issues, 0 keyboard traps, 0 controls unreachable by keyboard, no clickable divs.**

**Other checklist items**
- **Labels:** every input has htmlFor or aria-label (0 missing).
- **Autocomplete:** correct on all [SENSITIVE_PATH] fields, including `one-time-code` plus a numeric keypad on both TOTP inputs.
- **Focus ring:** visible everywhere (2px accent, 5.47:1); no `outline-none` anywhere.
- **Basics in place:** `lang="en"`, landmarks, no skipped heading levels, a global `prefers-reduced-motion` override, and `scope="col"` on every table header.
- **Touch targets:** `.btn` is about 35px tall. That passes 2.5.8 (24px, WCAG 2.2 AA) but not 2.5.5 (44px, AAA). WCAG 2.1 AA has no target-size requirement.

**Done well (8 in the file), notably:**
1. The Dialog plus focus-trap primitive: aria-modal, Escape, Tab wrap, and focus returned to the exact claim link when the sheet closes.
2. Zero clickable divs; native `button`, `a`, `dl`, `fieldset`, `progress`.
3. Sortable headers use `aria-sort` with a real button inside.
4. Context-rich names such as "Revoke KEYNAME" and "Correct FIELD".
5. Correct autocomplete tokens and APG-style tabs.
6. Status is never shown by colour alone; every badge has text.
